items.title: Iran balances ties with China and Russia as Trump ramps up pressure
items.desc: As Donald Trump seeks to tighten economic pressure on Iran, China remains its biggest oil customer and Russia a key partner. But both powers are balancing support for Tehran against broader interests with Washington.

items.title: Faahfaahin kasoo baxaysa hooyo loo xiray inay labadeeda carruurta ah ku dishay Minnesota
items.desc: Booliisku waxay sheegeen in haweeney ay wacday lambarka gurmadka degdegga ah ee 911, iyadoo sheegtay in carruurteeda la toogtay. Haweeneyda ayaa la xiray isla markii ay goobta soo gaareen saraakiisha ammaanku.
